glosses: southeast, southeastern (relating to the southeast direction)
southeast, southeastward (situated towards or in the direction of the southeast)

examples.text: A Croácia fica no sudeste da Europa.
examples.en: Croatia is in the southeastern part of Europe.

examples.text: A Croácia e um país ao sudeste de Europa.
examples.en: Croatia is a country in southeastern Europe.

examples.text: A Croácia e um país localizado na região sudeste da Europa.
examples.en: Croatia is a country located in the southeastern part of Europe.
